DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出先から証明書の指定があれば、見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: If the receiving organization has specified the certificate they need, could you show me the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先のこの紙では、世帯全員か本人だけか分かりません。どちらを出せばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指定書で世帯全員か本人のみか分からないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This paper from my employer doesn't make clear whether it should cover everyone in my household or just me. Which should I submit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the specification does not make clear whether everyone in the household or only you should be included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらにも印がありませんね。勤務先が求める範囲は、提出先へ確認していただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Neither option is marked. You'll need to check with the receiving organization about the scope your employer requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 不要な家族の情報まで出したくないので、今、勤務先へ電話で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不要な家族情報を避けるため勤務先へ電話確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I don't want to provide unnecessary information about my family, so I'll call my employer now to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will call your employer to check so you can avoid providing unnecessary family information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記載項目も、一緒に確認されるとよいと思います。確認が済んだらお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to check the required entries at the same time. Please let me know once you've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞いてきました。本人だけの住民票で、本籍と個人番号は不要だそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人のみで本籍と個人番号不要という確認結果を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've asked. They want a certificate of residence for just me, without my registered domicile or Individual Number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that they confirmed it should cover only you, without your registered domicile or Individual Number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容で申請書を確認しましょう。発行する枚数にも指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the application with those details. Did they specify how many copies to have issued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一枚を提出します。自分の控えはコピーにするので、発行は一枚でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出は一枚で控えをコピーするため発行一枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll submit one. I'll photocopy it for my own records, so please issue just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for one copy to be issued because you will submit one and photocopy it for your records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。本人確認後に発行手続きへ進みます。受領時には名前と住所などもお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll proceed with issuing it after verifying your identity. When you receive it, please check your name, address, and other details too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取ったら名前と住所を見ます。本人だけで、本籍と個人番号のない一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受領時の確認を約束し範囲と省略項目と枚数を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check my name and address when I get it. One copy, covering only me and omitting my registered domicile and Individual Number, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to check it on receipt and repeat the scope, omitted entries, and number of copies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その申請内容を確認しました。順番にお呼びしますのでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we've confirmed those application details. We'll call you in order, so please wait. I'll excuse myself now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で分からない言葉があれば、お尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please ask if there are any words on the medical questionnaire you don't understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「しびれ」の意味が分かりません。手に力が入りにくいことも、しびれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: しびれの意味を尋ね力の入りにくさも含むか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand what “numbness” means. Does difficulty putting strength into my hand count as numbness too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what numbness means and whether it includes difficulty exerting strength. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 力の入りにくさと感覚の変化は、分けて伝えると分かりやすいです。ピリピリした感じもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: It will be clearer if you describe difficulty exerting strength separately from changes in sensation. Do you also have a tingling feeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ピリピリはしません。右手で瓶のふたを回そうとしても、うまく力が入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 感覚ではなく瓶のふたを回す際の右手の力の入りにくさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There's no tingling. When I try to turn a bottle cap with my right hand, I can't apply strength properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe difficulty applying strength with your right hand when turning a bottle cap, rather than a change in sensation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その様子をそのまま書きましょう。いつからですか。急な変化なら、すぐ診療担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's write exactly what is happening. When did it start? If it's a sudden change, I'll tell the clinical staff immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝起きたときに気づきました。昨夜は普通にふたを開けられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝気づき昨夜は普通にできたという経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I noticed it when I woke up this morning. Last night, I could open caps normally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed it this morning and could do it normally last night. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今朝からの右手の変化ですね。担当者へすぐ知らせます。ほかに普段と違うことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: A change in your right hand since this morning, then. I'll notify the staff member immediately. Is anything else different from usual?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今のところ右手だけです。話しにくさや頭痛はありませんが、原因は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右手以外の変化と話しにくさや頭痛がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So far, it's only my right hand. I don't have difficulty speaking or a headache, but I don't know the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe whether anything besides your right hand has changed, and say that you have no difficulty speaking or headache. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原因は医師に確認してもらいましょう。問診票を全部書く前に担当者が伺いますので、ここでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's have the doctor check the cause. A staff member will come to you before you finish the whole questionnaire, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。しびれと決めつけず、今朝から右手に力が入りにくいと書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機に同意し診断語を決めつけず症状そのものを記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. I won't assume it's numbness; I'll write that I've had difficulty exerting strength in my right hand since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to wait and write the symptoms themselves without deciding on a diagnostic term. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その説明を担当者にもお伝えください。状態が変わったらすぐお知らせくださいね。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please give that explanation to the staff member too. Let us know immediately if your condition changes. I'll excuse myself now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 連絡を受けてお困りでしょうか。どのような内容かお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you troubled by a message you received? Please tell me what it says.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない番号から動画の利用料を払えと来ました。そのような契約をした覚えがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない番号から契約の覚えのない動画料金を要求されたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unknown number sent me a demand to pay video usage fees. I don't remember signing up for anything like that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that an unknown number demanded video fees for a contract you do not remember making. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのメッセージは残っていますか。返事や支払いをされたかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have the message? Please also tell me whether you have replied or paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 残しています。返信も支払いもしていませんが、今日中に払えと書かれていて不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信も支払いもせず保存しているが当日の期限が不安だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've kept it. I haven't replied or paid, but it says to pay by the end of today, and I'm worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have saved it without replying or paying, but are worried about the same-day deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 焦って連絡せず、まず内容を確認しましょう。メッセージのリンクは開きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't rush to contact them. Let's check the contents first. Have you opened the link in the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開いていません。画面を保存するなら、どの部分を残せばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リンクを開いていないと伝え保存範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I haven't. If I save the screen, which parts should I keep?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not opened the link and ask which parts to save. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送信元、日時、要求の内容が分かる部分を保存してください。元のメッセージも残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Save the parts that show the sender, date and time, and what they are demanding. Please keep the original message too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その三つが見えるように保存します。電話がかかってきた場合も、日時を記録したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送信元と日時と要求内容を保存すると伝え電話の記録も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll save it so those three things are visible. If they call me too, should I record the date and time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will save the sender, date and time, and demand, and ask whether to record calls too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 着信の日時や番号も相談に役立ちます。相手から言われた内容も、覚えている範囲で残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The dates, times, and numbers of incoming calls are also useful when you seek advice. Please also keep a record of what they said, as far as you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 支払う前に相談することにします。メッセージも消さず、追加の着信も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い前に相談しメッセージと追加着信を残すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll seek advice before paying. I won't delete the message, and I'll record any further calls too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to seek advice before paying and keep the message and records of further calls. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、残っている内容を一緒に確認しましょう。ご相談いただきありがとうございます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check what you have kept together. Thank you for coming to us. I'll excuse myself now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 中身に合った送り方をご案内します。何を送られるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll explain a suitable way to send your items. What are you planning to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母に陶器の湯飲みを二つ送ります。割れないようにしたいのですが、この箱で大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 陶器の湯飲み二つを母へ割れないように送りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sending my mother two ceramic teacups. I don't want them to break. Is this box suitable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending two ceramic teacups to your mother without them breaking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の中の包み方も大切です。二つの湯飲みが触れないように包んでありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: How they're wrapped inside the box matters too. Have you wrapped the two cups so they don't touch each other?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それぞれ紙で包みましたが、箱を動かすと中でずれます。すき間は空いたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個別に紙で包んだがすき間が空き箱内でずれると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrapped each one in paper, but they shift inside when I move the box. I've left the gaps empty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they are individually wrapped in paper but shift inside because the gaps are empty. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: すき間にも緩衝材を詰めて、動かないようにしてください。底や側面でも陶器が直接箱に当たらないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please fill the gaps with cushioning material too so they don't move. Make sure the ceramics don't directly touch the bottom or sides of the box either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で包み直します。割れ物の表示を付けても、薄い梱包の代わりにはならないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家で包み直すと決め割れ物表示が梱包を補うものではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll rewrap them at home. Even if I add a fragile label, that doesn't make up for insufficient packaging, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to rewrap them at home and confirm that a fragile label cannot make up for inadequate packaging. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、表示だけでは中身を守れません。お届け先は国内ですか、それとも海外ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. A label alone can't protect the contents. Is the destination within Japan or overseas?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 国内です。母は平日留守なので、日時の希望を付けられるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 国内宛てで母が平日留守のため日時の希望を付けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Within Japan. My mother is out on weekdays, so I'd also like to know whether I can request a delivery date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is a domestic shipment and ask whether you can request a date and time because your mother is out on weekdays. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先と発送方法で扱いを確認します。料金も、包み直したあとの大きさと重さで調べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check what is available for the address and shipping method. Let's also check the cost using the size and weight after repacking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、包み直して母の住所を持ってきます。そのときに日時の希望と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再梱包と宛先準備後に再来店し日時と料金を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll rewrap them and bring my mother's address. I'll check the delivery date and time request and the price then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to repack, prepare the address, and return to check the delivery date and time and the cost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。中で動かないか確認してからお持ちください。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please check that they don't move inside before bringing them in. We'll be here when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の指定書をお持ちですね。確認されたい点を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the transfer instructions with you. Please tell me what you'd like to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めて家賃を振り込みます。私の名前の前に契約番号を入れるように書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の初回振込で名前の前に契約番号を入力する指定があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first rent transfer. It says to enter my contract number before my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that this is your first rent transfer and the instructions require the contract number before your name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 依頼人名の指定ですね。受取人の名前と口座情報も記載されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's an instruction for the sender name. Are the recipient's name and account details listed too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありますが、会社名が漢字です。画面にカタカナで表示されたときに合っているか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 漢字の会社名と画面のカタカナ名の一致に不安があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, but the company name is in kanji. I'm worried about whether it will match when the screen displays it in katakana.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are worried whether the kanji company name matches the katakana name on the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示された名前を指定書と照合しましょう。不明な場合は、送る前に管理会社へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the displayed name with the instructions. If you are unsure, check with the management company before sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 違う名前なら送らずに管理会社へ聞きます。番号は依頼人名の欄に入れるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前が違えば送らず問い合わせると決め番号の入力欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: If the name is different, I won't send it; I'll ask the management company. The number goes in the sender-name field, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to send if the name differs and to make an inquiry, and confirm which field to enter the number in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、指定された順番で入力します。最後に番号が省略されていないかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, enter it in the specified order. At the end, also check that the number has not been left out or cut off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号と名前が全部入っているか見ます。手数料は家賃に足して相手へ送るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 依頼人名の全文を確認すると伝え手数料を家賃に加えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check that the entire number and name are entered. Should I add the fee to the rent amount and send it to the recipient?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the full sender-name entry, and ask whether the fee should be added to the rent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送金額と銀行への手数料は別です。家賃は指定された金額を入力し、手数料は画面の表示で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The transfer amount and the fee paid to the bank are separate. Enter the specified rent amount, and check the fee displayed on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家賃額は変えず、手数料は別に確認します。受取人名と契約番号を見てから実行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家賃額を変えず手数料を別に確認し受取人と番号の照合後に実行すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't change the rent amount, and I'll check the fee separately. I'll check the recipient's name and contract number before making the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the rent amount unchanged, check the fee separately, and proceed after checking the recipient and contract number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でお確かめください。迷ったら確定前にお呼びください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check in that order. If you are unsure, call us before confirming. Thank you for coming in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い物袋はお持ちですか。冷凍食品とパンをお分けしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a shopping bag? Would you like the frozen food and bread separated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋を家に忘れたので買います。一枚で冷凍食品とパンが入るでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋を忘れ購入したいと伝え冷凍食品とパンが一枚に入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my bag at home, so I'll buy one. Will the frozen food and bread fit in one bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot your bag and want to buy one, and ask whether the frozen food and bread will fit in one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入りますが、パンがつぶれないよう二枚に分けることもできます。袋は一枚ごとに、この表示の料金がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: They will fit, but you can also use two bags to avoid squashing the bread. Each bag costs the amount displayed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚ください。冷凍食品をまとめて、パンは別の袋にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋二枚を選び冷凍食品とパンを別にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two bags, please. I'll put the frozen food together and the bread in a separate bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose two bags and say that you will separate the frozen food from the bread. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚を付けます。保冷用の袋ではないので、お持ち帰りの時間にもお気をつけください。お支払い方法はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll add two bags. They aren't insulated bags, so please also be mindful of how long your journey home takes. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スマートフォンのこの決済を使えますか。レジのマークとアプリが同じか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: スマートフォン決済が使えるか表示とアプリを確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I use this payment service on my smartphone? I'd like to check whether the mark at the register matches my app.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your smartphone payment service can be used and to check the displayed mark against your app. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: このマークのサービスに対応しています。お客様の画面でもサービス名をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We accept the service with this mark. Please check the service name on your screen too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ名前でしたが、残高が足りません。現金払いに変えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: サービス名は同じだが残高不足のため現金への変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name is the same, but I don't have enough balance. May I change to cash?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the service name matches but the balance is insufficient, and ask to change to cash. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ決済前ですので変更できます。商品と袋二枚を合わせた合計はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You haven't paid yet, so you can change. Here is the total for the items and the two bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この合計を現金で払います。袋を受け取ったら、パンを分けてから詰めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計額を現金で払いパンを分けて袋詰めすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pay this total in cash. Once I get the bags, I'll separate the bread before packing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay the total in cash and separate the bread when packing your bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。レシートと袋二枚をお受け取りください。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've confirmed your payment. Please take your receipt and two bags. Thank you. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先の道についてご案内しましょうか。どちらへ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like directions for the path ahead? Where are you heading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三十分後に噴水で友人と会います。それまで少し歩きたいのですが、今日は疲れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分後の噴水での集合と疲れを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm meeting a friend at the fountain in thirty minutes. I'd like a short walk until then, but I'm tired today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Mention your meeting at the fountain in thirty minutes and that you are tired. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遠くへ行かず、噴水の周りで過ごす方法もあります。日陰で座れる場所がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You could stay around the fountain instead of going far. Would somewhere to sit in the shade be good?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、日陰で休みたいです。階段を使わずに行ける場所がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日陰で休み階段を使わずに行ける場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I'd like to rest in the shade. I'd prefer somewhere I can reach without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for somewhere to rest in the shade that you can reach without using stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右手の木陰に休憩所があります。歩道を進めば階段はありませんが、途中で清掃をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a rest area under the trees on your right. If you follow the walkway, there are no stairs, but cleaning is underway along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 清掃している道は通れますか。通れなければ、噴水の近くで休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃区間の通行可否を尋ね通れなければ噴水近くで休むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Can I use the path where they're cleaning? If not, I'll rest near the fountain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can pass through the section being cleaned, and say you will rest near the fountain if you cannot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作業中と表示された区間は避けてください。別の通路でも休憩所へ行けますが、少し遠回りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please avoid the section marked as work in progress. Another path also leads to the rest area, but it's a slight detour.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 集合までに戻れないと困るので、噴水の横のベンチにします。あそこは使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合に間に合うため噴水横のベンチを選び使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd be in trouble if I couldn't get back by our meeting time, so I'll choose the bench beside the fountain. Can I use that one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the bench beside the fountain so you can meet on time, and ask whether you can use it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は空いていて作業範囲の外です。友人が見つけやすいよう、座る場所を知らせておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's free now and outside the work area. It would help to tell your friend where you'll sit so they can find you easily.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 噴水の横で待つと友人に連絡します。今日は歩き回らず、合流してから帰り道を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ場所を知らせ歩かずに待ち合流後に帰り道を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my friend I'll wait beside the fountain. I won't walk around today; we'll decide the route home after meeting up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your friend the location, wait without walking around, and decide the route home after meeting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりお休みください。ご友人との時間もお楽しみくださいね。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please have a good rest. Enjoy your time with your friend too. I'll excuse myself now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いま案内板を更新しています。お急ぎのご用件がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: We're updating the information board now. Do you have something urgent to get to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十一時から面接があります。この列車で間に合う予定でしたが、どのくらい遅れているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面接時刻と列車遅延の程度を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an interview at eleven. I was expecting to arrive on time on this train, but how delayed is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your interview time and ask about the extent of the train delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 運転再開の時刻は、まだ連絡が来ていません。案内板の予定時刻を、そのまま到着の保証として使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We haven't yet received word on when services will resume. Please don't treat the scheduled time on the information board as a guarantee of arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 再開時刻が未定なんですね。面接先へ連絡するので、列車が遅れていて到着時刻はわからないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再開未定を面接先へ伝える方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the resumption time hasn't been decided. I'll contact the interview location and tell them the train is delayed and I don't know when I'll arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to tell the interview location that the resumption time is not yet known. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その伝え方で状況がわかりますね。待つ場合は放送と案内板をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That will convey the situation clearly. If you wait, please check the announcements and information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 面接先が開始を少し遅らせてくれました。ただ、車で迎えに来てもらう案もあるので、改札を出た後で戻れるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 面接延期と迎え案を説明し改札再入場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: They've agreed to delay the interview's start a little. But having someone pick me up by car is also an option, so I'd like to check whether I can return after leaving through the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the interview postponement and possible car pickup, and ask about re-entering the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの切符と利用状況によって確認が必要です。出る前に改札の係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: That needs to be checked based on your ticket and how you've used it. Please ask the gate staff before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、切符を見せてから決めます。迎えを頼む場合に備えて、駅前の待ち合わせ場所も係員に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符確認と駅前集合場所の照会を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll show them my ticket before deciding. I'll also ask the staff about a meeting place in front of the station in case I request a pickup.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to have your ticket checked and ask about a meeting place in front of the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。まだ迎えが決まっていないうちは、出発したことにして連絡しないほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. While the pickup is still undecided, it's best not to contact anyone as though you have already set off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に改札で確認し、その結果を家族へ伝えます。列車を待つか車にするか、そこで決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札確認後に家族と交通手段を決定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check at the gates first and tell my family the outcome. We'll decide then whether to wait for the train or take a car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on transport with your family after checking at the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 面接先にも変更をお知らせくださいね。改札へお気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell the interview location about any change too. Take care on your way to the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約をご希望ですね。どのような内容か簡単に伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to book a consultation. Could you briefly tell me what it's about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の片付けで大きな棚を処分したいです。一人では運べず、普通の収集日に出してよいかもわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな棚の処分と運べない事情を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm clearing out my home and want to dispose of a large shelving unit. I can't carry it alone, and I don't know whether I can put it out on the ordinary collection day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to dispose of a large shelving unit and cannot carry it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ごみの担当が、品目やお住まいの地区に応じて確認します。棚の大きさは測ってありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The waste department will check based on the item and the area you live in. Have you measured the unit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 高さは百八十センチですが、幅と奥行きは測っていません。写真だけでも相談を予約できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既知の高さと未測定寸法を伝え予約資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's 180 centimeters tall, but I haven't measured its width or depth. Can I book a consultation with just a photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the height you know, mention the unmeasured dimensions, and ask what materials you need for booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談予約の受付に、わかる寸法と不明な項目を伝えましょう。写真だけで処分方法が決まるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's tell the consultation booking desk the dimensions you know and which ones are unknown. A photo alone may not be enough to determine the disposal method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、幅と奥行きも測ってから相談します。運び出しが難しいことは、予約するときに言ったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寸法測定と運び出し困難の事前説明を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll measure the width and depth too before consulting them. Should I mention the difficulty getting it out when I make the appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss measuring the dimensions and explaining in advance that getting it out is difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。処分の分類と運び出しの問題を分けて伝えると、担当が確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Describing the disposal category separately from the difficulty moving it out will make it easier for the staff to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平日の昼は仕事です。電話で予約を取れるか、最初に担当へ確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務時間と電話予約の可否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I work during weekday daytime hours. I'd first like to check with the department whether I can book by phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your working hours and say that you want to check whether booking by phone is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付方法や空き時間は担当からご案内します。この窓口で訪問や運び出しを約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The department will explain how to book and what times are available. This counter can't promise a visit or help moving it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 運び出してもらえると決めつけずに、寸法と地区と困っている点を用意して、担当へ電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訪問を期待せず品目地区寸法を整理して連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume they'll move it out for me. I'll prepare the dimensions, my area, and the difficulties I'm having, then call the department.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the item, area, and dimensions before contacting them, without expecting a visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが担当への連絡先です。準備した内容をお伝えください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the department's contact information. Please tell them what you've prepared. Thank you for asking us. I'll excuse myself now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はお済みですね。受診の書類について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've finished paying. Is there something you need help with regarding documents for your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場へ受診したことを知らせたいのですが、この領収書で足りますか。明日の勤務を休む必要があるかも気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書の提出可否と翌日勤務の判断を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to let my employer know I attended a medical appointment. Is this receipt enough? I'm also wondering whether I need to take tomorrow off work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the receipt can be submitted and about deciding whether to work tomorrow. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が求める書類は職場へご確認ください。また、勤務を休む判断は領収書からできないので、医師への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with your employer about the documents they require. Also, the receipt can't determine whether you need time off, so you'll need to check with the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の連絡を見ると、受診日の確認できる書類と書いてあります。休む日数については、診察で聞き忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社の必要書類文言と診察での聞き忘れを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Looking at the company's message, it says a document that confirms the date of the appointment. I forgot to ask during the examination how many days I should take off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the company's wording about the required document and explain what you forgot to ask at the appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、受付には書類のことを、医師には勤務について質問したいことをお伝えします。職場でどのような作業をしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll tell reception about the document and the doctor that you have a question about work. What tasks do you do at work?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物を持ち上げる仕事です。痛みがあるので、その作業を明日してよいか、医師に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を持つ仕事と作業可否の質問を具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My job involves lifting packages. I'm in pain, so I'd like to ask the doctor whether I can do that task tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe your package-lifting work and make your question about whether you can do it specific. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その仕事内容も伝えます。診断書を追加で頼む場合には、受付で作成の可否や費用を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on that description of your work too. If you request an additional medical certificate, please ask reception whether they can prepare it and what it costs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今すぐ診断書を頼むのではなく、まず領収書の受診日を会社に見せて、必要な書類名を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診断書を急がず会社の必要書類名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than requesting a medical certificate right away, I'll first show the company the appointment date on the receipt and check the name of the document they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the required document name with your company without rushing to request a medical certificate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。医師への質問はこのあと確認しますので、こちらでお待ちください。明日の勤務が可能と私から断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll check your question for the doctor shortly, so please wait here. I can't state that you are able to work tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。会社には勤務についてまだ医師の返答待ちと伝え、確認できるまで無理に荷物を持たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 医師返答待ちを会社へ伝え無理な動作を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll tell the company I'm still waiting for the doctor's response about work, and I won't force myself to lift packages until it's confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your company you are waiting for the doctor's response, and avoid forcing yourself to make strenuous movements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 質問を引き継いでまいります。書類をお手元に置いてお待ちください。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your question. Please keep your documents with you and wait. I'll excuse myself for now.
